kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the block's header + four-row selectivity table.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the drug table; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The THREE-WAY FORK frame — the printed table read as one question asked of every α drug: WHICH α RECEPTOR does it block? NONSELECTIVE (phenoxybenzamine, phentolamine — both α1 and α2 blocked: the vasodilation plus the presynaptic-brake release of the autoreceptor sentence of book 238) vs α1-SELECTIVE (the -osin four — the vascular and visceral smooth-muscle addresses of books 236/237 relaxed without the central story) vs α2-SELECTIVE (mirtazapine — the presynaptic brake RELEASED, the antidepressant direction, the receptor mirror of the completed PH22's agonists on the same page above). Every group label is the book's own print ('Nonselective', 'α1 selective (-osin ending)', 'α2 selective'); the fork compression that turns three group labels into one sorting question is KYP's.
kypExtensions.rationale: The book prints the group labels and the rows; the single-question selectivity fork that unifies them with the anchor pages (236/237/238) is KYP's synthesis.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + mechanisms[0] + the visual's fork cards

kypExtensions.summary: The PHEO-PROTOCOL frame — the preoperative pheochromocytoma sequence: the irreversible nonselective α-blockade (phenoxybenzamine) FIRST, the β-blocker only AFTER adequate α-blockade (a β-blocker first leaves the tumor's catecholamine surge acting on UNOPPOSED α1 receptors → hypertensive crisis), with volume repletion and the phentolamine-on-hand rule for intraoperative crisis. The printed cells carry only 'Pheochromocytoma (used preoperatively) to prevent catecholamine (hypertensive) crisis.' — the α-before-β ORDERING rule, the dosing weeks, and the volume story are NOT printed on this page and are flagged as KYP wherever used, never cited as printed.
kypExtensions.rationale: The book prints the preoperative use and the crisis it prevents; the ordering rule and the perioperative protocol are KYP's clinical overlay.
kypExtensions.location: usmle patterns[0] + traps[0] + the miniCase + the visual's nonselective card

kypExtensions.summary: Two printed-cell frames read through KYP lenses: (1) the -OSIN SUFFIX frame — the book's own '(-osin ending)' label read as the naming rule (every -osin is an α1-selective blocker) joined to the book's own 'except tamsulosin' exception read as the BPH-selective member (prostate-selective α1A affinity, minimal blood-pressure effect — the subtype reading is KYP's, not printed); (2) the FIRST-DOSE frame — the printed '1st-dose orthostatic hypotension, dizziness, headache.' read with its management rule (give the first dose at bedtime, start low, titrate slow — NOT printed, KYP-flagged): the orthostatic fall is a FIRST-DOSE phenomenon, the printed '1st-' is the whole point.
kypExtensions.rationale: The book prints the suffix label, the exception clause, and the 1st-dose cell; the naming-rule reading, the subtype story, and the bedtime-dose management are KYP's overlays.
kypExtensions.location: mnemonics[1] + mnemonics[3] + usmle traps[1]/pivots + the visual's α1 card and toxicity strip

kypExtensions.summary: Two census flags: (1) the EPINEPHRINE-REVERSAL LINK — the connection between this block's nonselective rows and the α-blockade graphs printed one page behind (book 242, the completed sympathomimetics: 'Epinephrine response exhibits reversal of mean arterial pressure from a net increase (the α response) to a net decrease (the β2 response).' + 'After α-blockade' + the phenylephrine-suppression caption) — the graphs are the book's own print, but their attribution to phenoxybenzamine/phentolamine is KYP's bridge (that page prints them in the sympathomimetics context, never naming an α-blocker); (2) the PH22/PH23 BOUNDARY CENSUS itself — pdf 265 (book 243) prints TWO separable sections under the one banner, and the two book-243 topics ARE separable on inspection: the COMPLETED PH22 (sympatholytics-alpha-2-agonists) = the UPPER block (lines 9-37), EXCLUDED here, only its header + last row pinned from below; THIS topic (alpha-blockers) = the LOWER class table (lines 39-78 + the shared footer, line 80); and pdf 266 ahead opens 'β-blockers' (the PENDING beta-blockers topic) — sourcePages = [265] only.
